# TossMap — full facility listings

Every listing below is verified against an official government or facility-operator source and includes that source URL and a last-checked date. TossMap lists 221 drop-off sites across 54 US metro areas in 31 states. TossMap does not operate these facilities. Rules and hours can change; confirm with the official source before driving.

A shorter index is in https://tossmap.com/llms.txt.

## Arizona

### Phoenix, AZ

Name: North Gateway Transfer Station
City/state: Phoenix, AZ
Address: 30205 N. Black Canyon Hwy., Phoenix, AZ 85085
Materials accepted: Passenger car tires (5 per year, rims removed; no off-road, semi or motorcycle tires), appliances, CRT and non-CRT TVs (2 CRTs/month free), household trash
Hours: Mon–Fri 5:30am–5pm; Sat 6am–3pm; closed Sun & listed city holidays
Fees: Residents: one load up to 1 ton/month free with city services bill + matching photo ID; otherwise $55/ton ($40 min); extra CRTs $20 each
Official source: https://www.phoenix.gov/administration/departments/publicworks/about-us/transfer-stations.html
Last checked: 2026-11-15
TossMap page: https://tossmap.com/az/phoenix/north-gateway-transfer-station/

Name: 27th Avenue Transfer Station
City/state: Phoenix, AZ
Address: 3060 S. 27th Ave., Phoenix, AZ 85009
Materials accepted: Passenger car tires (5 per year, rims removed; no off-road, semi or motorcycle tires), appliances, CRT and non-CRT TVs (2 CRTs/month free), household trash
Hours: Mon–Fri 5:30am–5pm; Sat 6am–3pm; closed Sun & listed city holidays
Fees: Residents: one load up to 1 ton/month free with city services bill + matching photo ID; otherwise $55/ton ($40 min); extra CRTs $20 each
Official source: https://www.phoenix.gov/administration/departments/publicworks/about-us/transfer-stations.html
Last checked: 2026-11-15
TossMap page: https://tossmap.com/az/phoenix/27th-avenue-transfer-station/

### Tucson, AZ

Name: Los Reales Sustainability Campus HHW
City/state: Tucson, AZ
Address: 5300 E Los Reales Rd, Tucson, AZ 85756
Materials accepted: Household hazardous waste (paint, chemicals, pesticides, automotive fluids, batteries, bulbs)
Hours: Thu–Sat 7am–2pm (closed 2nd Sat except summer)
Fees: Free for Tucson residents; $15 for listed nearby residents
Official source: https://www.tucsonaz.gov/Departments/Environmental-Services/Household-Hazardous-Waste
Last checked: 2026-11-02
TossMap page: https://tossmap.com/az/tucson/los-reales-sustainability-campus-hhw/

### Sacramento, CA

Name: North Area Recovery Station HHW Drop-Off
City/state: Sacramento, CA
Address: 4450 Roseville Rd, North Highlands, CA
Materials accepted: Household hazardous waste (paint, chemicals, pesticides, automotive fluids, batteries, bulbs)
Hours: Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 8:30am–4pm
Fees: not listed
Official source: https://wmr.saccounty.gov/content/wmr/us/en/county-facilities/north-area-recovery-station/nars-hhw-drop-off.html
Last checked: 2026-11-25
TossMap page: https://tossmap.com/ca/sacramento/north-area-recovery-station-hhw-drop-off/

Name: Kiefer Landfill (tires, e-waste & ABOP drop-off)
City/state: Sacramento, CA
Address: 12701 Kiefer Blvd., Sloughhouse, CA 95683
Materials accepted: Free residential drop-off: passenger/light-truck tires (rims OK, 4 per day free), e-waste (TVs, CRTs, monitors, computers, laptops, tablets, phones, printers, gaming consoles, stereos), large appliances (2 per day free), small corded appliances and power tools, mattresses and box springs, clean metal, clean inerts. ABOP & Special Waste facility (residents): antifreeze, household and car batteries, motor oil and filters, cooking oil, latex and oil-based paint, aerosol cans, brake/transmission fluid, fluorescent tubes and bulbs (12 tubes per month), home-generated sharps in sealed containers, mercury thermometers and switches, barbecue propane tanks (limit two). Not accepted at ABOP: acids, household cleaners, pesticides and herbicides, solvents, paint thinners, gasoline, pool chemicals, ammunition, explosives, medical waste. Products with built-in batteries go to the e-waste area. Also takes household trash, green waste and treated wood (fees)
Hours: Landfill: Mon–Fri 6:30am–4:30pm; Sat–Sun 8:30am–4:30pm (arrive at least 15 minutes before closing; may close early if the daily vehicle limit is reached). Thanksgiving Day closes at 2pm; Christmas and New Year's Day close at 2pm on weekdays, all day on weekends. ABOP & Special Waste drop-off: Tue–Sat 8:30am–4pm (closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Day)
Fees: Free for residents: tires 1–4 per day, e-waste, appliances 1–2 per day, mattresses, clean metal, and ABOP items up to 15 gallons or 125 pounds per month (a load must contain only free items). Tires 5–8 per day $10 each; commercial/semi tires $30 each; trash loads $10 (cars) to $45 (large vans) per vehicle, or $61.35 per ton weighed (2026 fees)
Official source: https://wmr.saccounty.gov/content/wmr/us/en/county-facilities/kiefer-landfill.html
Last checked: 2026-11-25
TossMap page: https://tossmap.com/ca/sacramento/kiefer-landfill-tires-e-waste-abop/

Name: Elk Grove Special Waste Collection Center
City/state: Sacramento, CA
Address: 9255 Disposal Lane, Elk Grove, CA 95624
Materials accepted: Household hazardous waste: latex and oil-based paint, paint thinner and stripper, varnish; motor oil, antifreeze, transmission fluid, gasoline and diesel; auto and motorcycle batteries and household batteries; fluorescent and LED bulbs, mercury devices; pesticides, herbicides and fertilizer; pool chemicals; household cleaners; aerosol cans; cooking oil and grease; propane cylinders (5 gal or less); household fire extinguishers; smoke alarms; over-the-counter medicines; sharps in rigid containers; non-friable asbestos (special packaging, max 125 lb). Electronics: TVs (CRT, LCD, plasma), computers, laptops, monitors, tablets, cell phones, telephones, printers, copiers, fax machines, radios and stereos, VCR/DVD players. Not accepted: trash, mattresses, Styrofoam (EPS), explosives and ammunition, infectious medical waste, large compressed gas cylinders, radioactive waste, treated wood, prescription (controlled) medications
Hours: Residents: Sat–Wed 9am–4pm. Reuse Room: Sat–Wed 9am–3:30pm (Elk Grove residents only). Small businesses: Wednesdays by appointment only. Closed all City holidays, including Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve and New Year's Day
Fees: No fee for Sacramento County residents; proof of residency required (photo ID, utility bill or similar)
Official source: https://elkgrove.gov/recycling-and-waste/household-hazardous-waste
Last checked: 2026-11-25
TossMap page: https://tossmap.com/ca/sacramento/elk-grove-special-waste-collection-center/

Name: City of Sacramento HHW Facility (Sacramento Recycling and Transfer Station)
City/state: Sacramento, CA
Address: 8491 Fruitridge Road, Sacramento, CA 95826
Materials accepted: Household hazardous waste: latex and oil-based paint, paint thinners, solvents; used motor oil and filters, antifreeze, brake/transmission fluid, automotive products, gasoline and other flammables; car batteries and household batteries; fluorescent lamps and tubes, mercury thermometers; pesticides and herbicides; pool chemicals; household cleaners; acids and bases; aerosol cans; kitchen oils; propane cylinders; flares; vape pens and e-cigarettes; sharps (special packaging); electronic waste (anything with a plug or that runs on batteries). Not accepted: air bags, ammunition, asbestos, compressed gas cylinders (except propane and handheld aerosols), explosives and fireworks, infectious and medical waste (except sharps), medications, radioactive and reactive waste, treated wood
Hours: Tue–Sat 8am–5pm
Fees: Free (maximum 15 gallons or 125 lbs per trip)
Official source: https://www.cityofsacramento.gov/content/dam/portal/pw/RSW/2026-27-service-guide/2026-2027-service-guide-/SacRecycles_2026-2027_ServiceGuide_WEB_v1.0-A_508.pdf
Last checked: 2026-11-25
TossMap page: https://tossmap.com/ca/sacramento/city-of-sacramento-hhw-facility-srts/

Name: Fairfax County I-66 Transfer Station (HHW & e-waste)
City/state: Washington, DC
Address: 4618 West Ox Road, Fairfax, VA 22030
Materials accepted: Household hazardous waste: aerosols, antifreeze and automotive fluids, gasoline, motor oil, rechargeable batteries, cooking oil, pool chemicals, household cleaners, lawn and garden chemicals and pesticides, oil-based paint, paint thinners, stains and varnish, mercury devices, CFLs and fluorescent tubes, propane tanks up to 20 lb; e-waste (TVs, computers, gaming systems, keyboards, speakers, cords); separated recycling incl. used motor oil, antifreeze and automobile batteries; bicycles; textiles; household trash. Not accepted at HHW: ammunition, explosives, illegal fireworks, LED bulbs, radioactive materials, hazardous waste pharmaceuticals, propane tanks over 20 lb, compressed gas cylinders, business hazardous waste
Hours: Residents: trash, recycling and food scraps Mon–Fri 7am–5pm, Sat–Sun 7am–4pm. HHW and e-waste: Mon 7am–5pm; Tue and Thu 12–5pm; Fri 7am–5pm; Sat–Sun 7am–4pm; closed Wed. Holiday closures: see the county's holiday hours (complex closed Thanksgiving Day)
Fees: Household hazardous waste is free for Fairfax County residents; common 20 lb barbecue propane tanks are accepted for a fee
Official source: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/publicworks/recycling-trash/i-66-transfer-station
Last checked: 2026-11-24
TossMap page: https://tossmap.com/dc/washington/fairfax-county-i-66-transfer-station-hhw-e-waste/

Name: Fairfax County I-95 Landfill Complex (HHW & e-waste)
City/state: Washington, DC
Address: 9850 Furnace Road, Lorton, VA 22079
Materials accepted: Household hazardous waste: aerosols, antifreeze and automotive fluids, gasoline, motor oil, rechargeable batteries, cooking oil, pool chemicals, household cleaners, lawn and garden chemicals and pesticides, oil-based paint, paint thinners, stains and varnish, mercury devices, CFLs and fluorescent tubes, propane tanks up to 20 lb; e-waste (TVs, computers, gaming systems, keyboards, speakers, cords); separated recycling incl. used motor oil, antifreeze and automobile batteries; bicycles; textiles; household trash. Not accepted at HHW: ammunition, explosives, illegal fireworks, LED bulbs, radioactive materials, hazardous waste pharmaceuticals, propane tanks over 20 lb, compressed gas cylinders, business hazardous waste. Latex paint only drop-off at Lot B daily
Hours: Residents: trash, recycling and food scraps Mon–Fri 7am–5pm, Sat–Sun 7am–4pm. HHW and e-waste: Wed 7am–5pm and Sat 7am–4pm only. Latex-paint-only drop-off (Lot B): Mon–Fri 7am–5pm, Sat–Sun 7am–4pm. Holiday closures: see the county's holiday hours
Fees: Household hazardous waste is free for Fairfax County residents; common 20 lb barbecue propane tanks are accepted for a fee
Official source: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/publicworks/recycling-trash/i-95-landfill-complex
Last checked: 2026-11-24

Name: Quarantine Road Landfill & Residential Recycling Center
City/state: Baltimore, MD
Address: 6100 Quarantine Road, Baltimore, MD

Name: Baltimore County Eastern Sanitary Landfill Drop-Off Center (White Marsh)
City/state: Baltimore, MD
Address: 6259 Days Cove Road, White Marsh, MD 21162
Materials accepted: Tires: up to four clean passenger tires, off rims (no racing slicks); electronics (PCs, VCRs, phones, TVs, monitors; residential only); used motor oil, diesel, heating and hydraulic oil (max 25 gallons, no 55-gallon drums); antifreeze; lead-acid (auto, boat) and rechargeable household/tool batteries; propane tanks up to 20 lb; mercury thermometers and thermostats; fluorescent bulbs (10 per visit); scrap metal; single-stream recycling; household trash; yard materials; gasoline (max 25 gallons). Not accepted here: paint, household chemicals/solvents and pesticides (take those to the Central Acceptance Facility in Cockeysville)
Hours: Mon–Sat 7:30am–3:30pm (no admittance after 3:15pm)
Fees: In most cases free for Baltimore County residents, up to 10 visits per year; after 10 visits, materials must go to the Eastern Sanitary Landfill at a prorated $125 per ton. Commercial haulers need a Baltimore County commercial account (MSW $125/ton, special handling $200/ton, organics and brush $65/ton); non-account holders pay a $10 minimum per transaction
Official source: https://www.baltimorecountymd.gov/departments/public-works/solid-waste/drop-off-centers

## Pennsylvania

### Philadelphia, PA

Name: Sanitation Convenience Center – Port Richmond
City/state: Philadelphia, PA
Address: 3901 Delaware Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19137
Materials accepted: Automotive tires (limit 4 per day); electronic waste including computers, monitors and televisions; latex or water-based paint (must be solidified with an absorbent such as kitty litter or newspaper); fluorescent light bulbs; lithium, rechargeable and lead-acid batteries; bulk items, large metal household items and appliances incl. items with refrigerants (limit 2 per day); mattresses and box springs (unwrapped); trash (up to 6 receptacles or 12 bags); recyclables; yard waste (paper bags only); Christmas trees. NOT accepted: construction debris

City/state: Richmond, VA

Materials accepted: Tires without rims (up to 8 per year); residential waste; household furniture; mattresses; car seats; major appliances (washers, dryers, stoves, water heaters); refrigerators, freezers, air conditioners and dehumidifiers (CFC removal fee); brush up to 6 in. diameter, yard and garden waste, leaves and pine needles; propane grill tanks (4–40 lb); rechargeable batteries and cell phones; homeowner-performed construction and demolition debris (building permit required). Not accepted: kitchen or food waste, liquids, paint, petroleum-based products, wet-cell batteries, asbestos and other hazardous products, automobile parts, concrete and masonry, stumps and logs over 6 in.
Hours: Tue, Wed & Fri 12:30–3:30pm; Sat 8am–4:30pm; closed on observed holidays and in inclement weather
Fees: Tires $1 per passenger tire, $2 per light-truck tire; residential waste $3 (car), $10 (pickup/SUV or single-axle trailer), $35 (dual-axle trailer); brush and yard waste free (dual-axle trailer $10); construction debris $3–$50; $10 CFC removal per appliance; $10 extra for vehicles with raised sides
Official source: https://www.hopewellva.gov/548/Citizens-Convenience-Center
Last checked: 2026-11-26
TossMap page: https://tossmap.com/va/richmond/hopewell-citizens-convenience-center/

City/state: Seattle, WA
Address: 1350 North 34th Street, Seattle, WA 98103
Materials accepted: Vehicle tires; vehicle batteries and scrap metal (recycling); household garbage and larger items; yard waste; appliances (no commercial appliances); household sharps.
